#     proofs/coverage/files/). Remaining rows cite proofs in fleet-solved
#     or walled families the capture cannot measure locally (COVERAGE.md
#     they convert only when a future capture measures those families)
#   | census-OUT-carve (p1-pgcryptofam, 2026-08-02) — the line belongs to a
#     NAMED family this lane's claim carved OUT of phase-1 scope, so it has no
#     in-scope oracle and is not a fuzz gap. Two sub-shapes, both required to
#     name their carve in the justification: (a) carved-FAMILY wrappers, e.g.
#     contrib/pgcrypto's cipher_err and the pgp_sym_*/pgp_pub_* fc wrappers,
#     whose cores (cipher.rs, pgp/* minus armor) are the OpenSSL-provider
#     family a later lane owns; (b) COST-BOUND carves, where the differential
#     target's cost probe refuses the input SYMMETRICALLY before either side
#     executes (bcrypt pinned 04 / shacrypt 1000 / xdes <= 255), because the
#     unbounded arm wedges an in-process harness by design. A cost-bound row
#     must cite an EXECUTABLE WITNESS (a #[test] driving the line directly),
#     so the carve records a bound on the HARNESS and never a gap in what is
#     known about the line. NOTE the mainstream shape this hides:
#     shacrypt.rs:462 is the DEFAULT no-rounds= sha-crypt output path, made
#     permanently invisible to pgcryptofam_diff by the sha cost pin — the one
#     line to surface if anyone asks what "100% minus exceptions" conceals.
# Every unreachable-arm row is const-decided (rustc const-folds the guard);
# where a fence is nontrivial prefer promotion to a Kani infeasibility proof.
# TWO CLASSES PROPOSED BY p1-lanes (adt/varlena, 2026-07-31) — flagged for
# adjudication, carried here so the residual is never silent:
#   | encoding-carve (the ratified database-encoding pin of the crate's
#     differential: arms reachable only under a server encoding the harness
#     does not pin. UTF8 is pinned as ENVIRONMENT, never computation, so
#     non-UTF8 error arms and single-byte fast paths cannot fire. Distinct
#     from locale-carve: encoding is a pin, collation is a carve. Each row
#     names the C counterpart raising the identical condition and the
#   | cross-crate-entry (the line's SQL/entry-point callers live in a
#     DIFFERENT crate — often one claimed by another lane — so no in-scope
#     entry point of THIS crate reaches it. Not a coverage hole and not
#     double-counted: the row names the owning crate/lane. Verified by
# MEASUREMENT NOTES (p1-laneg, not exceptions — executed lines the instrument
# leaves unmapped, the known multiline-format!-literal false-red class):
#     continuation line of format!() inside the EXECUTED unsupported-encoding
#     error arm (arm exercised by enc_tables_diff fam 2/4 error grid every
#     campaign; neighbors carry DA counts in the fleet capture 2026-07-30).

the out-of-datum fallback of a bounds-tolerant packed read. C walks these images with raw pointer arithmetic and no bound at all, so past the end of the datum C is UB; we return zeroes instead. Unreachable from the SQL surface (images come from the parsers or from trusted storage, and *_recv parses text rather than ingesting a raw image), which is why no exec covers it — it is a safety floor at a site where C has no check, not a ported-in constraint.
